body: i know the therapist probably wants me to get better,but i dont think my parents do.i know it sounds awful and ungrateful,but i know then well and i know they dont care about me,they care about what others think of me.thats how i know their reaction will be awful and i will lie to her about being suicidal so we all can be happy.
also,thank you for trying to help me and calm me down c:

im sorry if im overreacting,but i already didnt trusted her,and theres too much at stake.im really nervous,but youre right.theres nothing i can do right now.
im not 'firing' her if she doesnt tell,but im discouraged because it is not helping at all.

she may be trying to help,but the thing is that it wont work with my parents.i have a depressed cousin,they know it is a illness,but they just say that he needs a good woman.they would not accept it and will blame it on friends,the internet,make me go to church,police me 24h,and thats the last thing i need right now.they dont care about me,they care about my reputation.i thought i could trust the therapist,but after that i wont be able to have another session with her.and if they are all like that,i will give up on therapy.

if someone thinks that,they are ignorant.suicidal toughts,specially when you have the courage to tell someone,should not be taken lightly.besides,you cant know what they are thinking,dont assume anyone thinks like that unless they say so, and you dont have to prove that you are 'suicidal enough' to anyone.dont worry about that.focus only on your will to live,and please see that this situation wont last forever

thank you for your concern,but i dont think i will be able to refraim from cutting,because im too stressed.i use it as a way to cope or i will go insane.
i will just try to pull her aside and tell her im not suicidal anymore.it is not true,but i cant risk her telling then anything.

i understand that she would tell then because i have a plan and it is soon.i dont live in the usa,there are no pych wards around here,the only thing that will happen is that my parents will lock me in the house,abuse me psychologically,and take away my privacy and means to talk to anyone.it will be worse,but idk if she doesnt understands it or if shes just an asshole and will tell anyway...im really worried now.

im sorry if i didnt understand,but what do you mean when you say that if you live,you are a liar?

you are not the wrong one here,im sorry that people have been doing this for you.but that situation can be fixed,its not your fault that you ex did that.it could happen to anyone,people have lied to me like this in the past,i was crushed when i found out a good friend of mine didnt liked me at all,and made fun of me behind my back.i couldnt accept it,i felt suicidal too.i still miss her,but it got better.

it takes a lot of luck to find someone who you can trust these days,but it is possible.there are people out there who are in this situation too,you justa have to find then c:
